raw_translation: Wannan wani taimako ne na rage bayanan, ba a tabbatar da ɓoyewa ko kuma yarda da sirri ba. Wasu zurfafawa, kimomi masu yawa, haɗe-haɗe da rubutun kyauta na iya ci gaba da gane mutane. Ka duba duk fitarwa kuma ka samu nazarin sirri kafin ka raba bayanan da suka fi dacewa.
source: This is a data-minimization aid, not guaranteed anonymization or privacy compliance. Other columns, rare values, combinations and free text can still identify people. Review the entire output and obtain a privacy review before sharing sensitive data.
translation: Wannan wani taimako ne na rage bayanan, ba a tabbatar da ɓoyewa ko kuma yarda da sirri ba. Wasu zurfafawa, kimomi masu yawa, haɗe-haɗe da rubutun kyauta na iya ci gaba da gane mutane. Ka duba duk fitarwa kuma ka samu nazarin sirri kafin ka raba bayanan da suka fi dacewa.

raw_translation: The standard household support pays ZXQPH0000QXZ of each hourly spot-price amount above NOK ZXQPH0001QXZ/kWh before VAT, for eligible use up to ZXQPH0002QXZ kWh per month. Norgespris uses a fixed reference price of NOK ZXQPH0003QXZ/kWh including VAT (NOK ZXQPH0004QXZ without electricity VAT); its settlement uses the full month's area-average spot price and eligible metered use. The cap is ZXQPH0005QXZ kWh/month for a home or ZXQPH0006QXZ kWh/month for a holiday home. A household can choose one scheme, not both. Network charges and other fees are entered separately and added to all scenarios. The comparison uses the exact hourly data you provide; it does not fetch prices.
source: The standard household support pays 90% of each hourly spot-price amount above NOK 0.77/kWh before VAT, for eligible use up to 5,000 kWh per month.
